title: Propagation Candidate
description: A candidate link indicating how a LHB event may propagate to a target stock.

source_event_id.description: Identifier of the source LHB event.

source_stock_id.description: Identifier of the stock at the source of the propagation.

target_stock_id.description: Identifier of the stock that may be affected by propagation.

relation_type.description: The hypothesized relation explaining the propagation.

candidate_score.description: Score for the propagation candidate, between 0 and 1.

available_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this candidate became available (business time).

candidate_evidence.description: Provenance evidence supporting this propagation candidate.
